title: Learning preferences
description: 03_MEMORY/global/learning_preferences.json — machine-readable, cross-subject preferences for how sessions should run. These are stated preferences, not inferred traits, and they are the lowest-precedence instruction source: a preference never overrides the system contract or the memory protocol.

explanation_style.description: Starting rung on the explanation ladder. concrete_first is the default and the safest.

hint_eagerness.description: How readily hints are offered. Hints are always recorded regardless.

notation.description: Notation conventions the learner's courses use.

retrieval_at_session_start.description: Open each session with retrieval of the previous session's material.

interleaving.description: Mix two or three concepts per practice block rather than drilling one.

timezone.description: For scheduling only. Stored timestamps stay UTC.

require_text_legends.description: Always true in practice: meaning is never encoded in colour alone.
